row.evidence: ChurnZero's public help articles document SAML SSO for Okta and Azure only (users must already exist: the Okta email must match "a user account in ChurnZero"), and the REST API is a read-only add-on; no SCIM is documented publicly, but most of the help centre and the pricing page could not be read.
row.notes: New row. Unknown rather than none: churnzero.com (including /pricing/, which first returned a 404 page) then served a 'Checking your browser' bot challenge to every request and the headless renderer failed (ERR_TOO_MANY_RETRIES), and only 127 help-centre articles are public (the rest need login). In what is public: SAML 2.0 SSO via a custom Okta app or an Azure non-gallery app (the Okta OIN app is SAML only), SSO matches existing ChurnZero users (no JIT documented), and no SCIM or provisioning article. docs_url is the help-centre JSON export of the Okta SSO article (the HTML page blocks automated checks). pricing_page_url points to the developer reference because it holds the only first-party pricing statement found (the REST API is an add-on priced via the CSM). The REST API (OData v4, Basic auth with username:API key) only reads UserAccounts.

plans.name: REST API add-on
plans.notes: No public plan table could be loaded; this is the only priced item found on a first-party page.

auth.notes: HTTP Basic with ChurnZero username and the user's API key; the user needs the Developer Tools permission and the 'Bulk Read - User Accounts' permission for UserAccount.

rate_limits.text: Per instance per minute: 1-100 requests normal, 101-200 delayed, above 200 returns 429.

limitations.text: The REST API documents only GET operations on UserAccount; no user create, update or deactivate.

okta.notes: OIN page markup marks only SAML as checked. ChurnZero's own guide builds a custom SAML app instead.

entra.notes: ChurnZero says to create a non-gallery app; learn.microsoft.com churnzero-tutorial returned 404.

fallbacks.notes: Most help-centre articles require login; SSO signs in existing users.
